hour_source: unix_time; recorded clock, no inferred local timezone
excluded: all customer identity, demographics, location, merchant identity, history, absolute date, XGBoost
probability_calibration: none; theoretical threshold is a reference, not a calibration claim

logistic.amount: log1p -> cubic spline, 8 uniformly spaced knots fitted only on training -> StandardScaler

threshold_selection: exact maximum utility on threshold window only, include all-pass and all-flag, group tied scores; equal utility chooses fewer flags
selection_rules: fixed hyperparameters; no post-evaluation refit, model variant search, threshold changes or feature additions in v1
official_test: no prediction or submission in this experiment
limitation: all training months were descriptively inspected in EDA; June is reserved from fitting/selection, not an unseen blind dataset
